admission_question: Do at least three frozen images expose a repeated-post pedestrian door bank or gate lattice for which one functional portal-set region can be boxed before algorithm execution?
stop_rule: Materialize all six once, inspect pixels once, freeze every evaluable portal-set box, and run the algorithm only if at least three frames are evaluable.
fresh_gate: Top-3 portal-set membership must be at least 2/3 and strictly exceed the zero-recall generic proposal result on the IFC mechanism prefix. Top-1 and proposal count are descriptive. Run once without tuning.
claim_boundary: Passing source admission establishes only a fresh public RGB functional portal-set cohort. It does not establish target identity, public access, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, benefit, or safety.
